duplicate_rule: Any repeated finite acquisition timestamp is ambiguous, including identical values; preserve every candidate
inactive_rule: For named fitted/C fields only: prefix including all records at/before cutoff has only finite zeros and no invalid values; no whole-run inference; isolated zeros retained
missing_policy: Keep original blank as null; never use aligned zero as observed assay
sensor_status_policy: Require supplied, nonblank, exact Ok for strict-status candidate; no claim Ok validates field or assay
